content:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: high-rate 5xx spike on /generate (eu-west-1) — page fired to Eng Oncall (P1). Auto-escalate after 5m if no ack. Links: https://pd.example/incidents/INC12345

alex: ACK — taking first responder. grabbing brief.

tanya: on standby — can pick up customer comms if you want.

alex: thanks. quick triage: k8s ingress shows 502 churn, inference-runtime nodes reporting OOMKill on model-serve pods. stacktrace snippet in logs below.

alex: ```
[2026-03-15T09:27:41Z] inference-runtime[serve/pm-3] OOMKilled: exceeded memory limit 32Gi while loading model redwood/codec-2b
[2026-03-15T09:27:43Z] proxy ingress: 502 upstream reset by peer
[2026-03-15T09:28:00Z] autoscaler: scale-up requested for node-pool:inference-eu-ml
```

sam: looks like a bad model rollout or memory regression. Any recent deploys? ops-bot, do we have a cluster-event deploy tag?

ops-bot: recent deploys: 
- 2026-03-15T08:55:12 service: model-adapter v2.14.7 applied by ci-bot
- 2026-03-15T09:10:03 autoscaler: policy tweak (burst-threshold -> 0.7)

tanya: hmm v2.14.7 included a change that preloads KV-cache for some variants. Could increase memory pressure for 2B models.

alex: mitigation plan — steps: 
1) scale dedicated pool up (manual) to relieve OOMs
2) pin traffic to the previous model variant (codec-2b:v20260228) via routing rules
3) enable fallback routing to us-east for new requests if eu nodes saturate
4) open bridge if customer impact > 20% failures

lilian: +1 to pinning variant. I'll start a canary rollback to v20260228 on half of the eu nodes.

sam: I'll run this command to pin routing (do not run without confirmation):
```bash
redwoodctl route update --service inference --region eu-west-1 --pin-model codec-2b:v20260228 --force
```

alex: go ahead, sam. once pinned, we should watch failure rate and p99 latency. product-support: do we have customers with active SLAs on eu-west-1 right now?

product-support: Customer list: AcmeCorp (high), Finlytix (medium), LingoAI (low). AcmeCorp currently seeing 40% 5xx on their requests per our telemetry. They were on a demo run.

tanya: ok escalate customer comms to AcmeCorp — short status: investigating, mitigation underway, possible rollback/latency improvements in ~10-15m. tag @acme-eng.

alex: sam, confirm when routing pin complete.

sam: pinned. output:
```json
{"status":"success","routes_updated":12,"old_variant":"codec-2b:v20260301","new_variant":"codec-2b:v20260228"}
```

alex: seeing immediate drop in OOM kills on the pinned pods. failure rate trending down from 42% -> 14% in last 3m.

pagerbot: PagerDuty: incident INC12345 acknowledged by alex at 2026-03-15T09:31:05Z. SLA impacted customers flagged: AcmeCorp.

lilian: opening bridge now: https://zoom.example/bridge/INC12345. joining.

tanya: drafting customer message for AcmeCorp: 
"We observed elevated 5xx errors in eu-west-1 affecting requests to /generate. We've rolled back the model variant for your traffic and are seeing a significant reduction in errors. Our engineers are monitoring and will provide a follow-up in 30 minutes."

product-support: sending message now to AcmeCorp (via support portal).

alex: next steps: keep pinned variant for 2h while we validate memory/kv preload fix. create follow-up ticket for model-adapter rollback root cause (assign to eng-ml). Also consider temporary autoscaler policy revert if we see re-flap.

sam: opening ticket ENG-8472. linking logs and deploy diff.

ops-bot: note: auto-escalate cancelled since incident acknowledged. Duplicate-page suppression active for this PD key.

tanya: should we fail open to us-east for new sessions automatically? that could reduce customer impact but increases cross-region latency. proposal: enable soft-fallback for new sessions while pinned variant stays local. Thoughts?

alex: do it. enable soft-fallback and set weight 25% -> us-east for new sessions. monitor error delta.

sam: soft-fallback enabled. config snippet:
```json
{"fallback":"us-east-1","weight":25,"duration":"30m"}
```

lilian: monitoring dashboard: 5xx now 6% and trending downward. latency up ~120ms for routed sessions to us-east.

product-support: AcmeCorp replied: "Thanks, appreciate the quick response — let us know when stable."

alex: continuing to monitor. if metrics hold, we'll transition incident to P2 after 45m. leaving pagerduty incident open for now.

pagerbot: INFO: if you want PD incident ownership to transfer to SRE rotation after immediate mitigation, reply `@pagerbot transfer to SRE-rotation` in thread.

alex: transferring ownership to SRE-rotation in 30m unless someone objects.

sam: no objections. good handoff plan.

lilian: thumbs up.

alex: thanks team — nice quick triage. updating runbook and adding follow-ups.

pagerbot: PagerDuty: incident INC12345 status updated: Mitigated -> Monitoring. Last update at 2026-03-15T09:49:59Z.
